sources.title: ArtStation subscribe/pro page (blocked by anti-bot in this session)

limits.en: Free portfolio and community access with basic features; ad-supported.

keyLimits.en: Custom domain support, advanced analytics, priority support, ad-free experience.

cautions.en: The official artstation.com pricing pages returned HTTP 403 (anti-bot) in this session; the $9.95/mo (monthly) and $4.98/mo (annual) figures come from a secondary source (ArtStation Magazine) and a Studio tier at $29.99/mo was mentioned in search snippets but not independently confirmed on the official page.

capabilities.en: Hosts online portfolios for concept, 3D and game artists with a searchable community feed.
Includes a marketplace for selling brushes, assets, tutorials and prints.

limitations.en: Free tier is ad-supported and lacks custom domain and advanced analytics.
Primarily a visibility/portfolio platform, not a project management or client-delivery tool.

reason.en: Also used by creators to build visual portfolios and share work, though more general-purpose.

missingAlternatives.name: Behance
missingAlternatives.reason: Main direct competitor portfolio platform for creative professionals, not in the catalogue.

unknowns: The official artstation.com pricing pages (subscribe/pro and subscribe/compare) returned HTTP 403 (anti-bot) in this session; Studio plan price and exact free-plan limits could not be independently verified against the primary source.
Whether a Plus tier (mentioned at $6.99/mo in some third-party sources) is still current could not be confirmed.
